# Zylvie

High-converting cart software for solopreneurs to sell digital products and subscriptions.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/zylvie/.

## Actions

- **Create Product**: Create a new product.
- **Get Authenticating User** (read-only): Retrieve information about the currently authenticated user.
- **Unsubscribe Webhook**: Unsubscribe from a webhook by deleting the workflow object associated with the specified webhook url.
